# Font fixtures

These fixtures are downloaded from the official Google Fonts repository for
font-loading and monospace validation. They are test inputs, not copies of
fonts installed on the host system.

## Inconsolata Regular

- File: `Inconsolata-Regular.ttf`
- Family/style: Inconsolata Regular (monospace)
- Upstream project: https://github.com/googlefonts/Inconsolata
- Source file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/0f203e3740b5eb77e0b179dff1e5869482676782/ofl/inconsolata/static/Inconsolata-Regular.ttf
- Google Fonts revision: `0f203e3740b5eb77e0b179dff1e5869482676782` (`inconsolata: v3.001 added`)
- SHA-256: `0f11ac40d1618e1aa1adb7322a14980a0b0c943421124022073f83236d15f0d5`
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, reproduced in [`OFL.txt`](OFL.txt)
- License source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/0f203e3740b5eb77e0b179dff1e5869482676782/ofl/inconsolata/OFL.txt

The hash covers the exact binary checked into this repository. If the
upstream fixture is refreshed, update the revision, source URLs, and hash in
this document together.

## Abel Regular

This small proportional face is used by rejection tests to ensure a renderer
does not accept a non-monospace font as a monospace fixture.

- File: `Abel-Regular.ttf`
- Family/style: Abel Regular (proportional)
- Upstream project: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/abel
- Source file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/3b99d83d2625944fc0b8bd328d793fa819b92381/ofl/abel/Abel-Regular.ttf
- Google Fonts revision: `3b99d83d2625944fc0b8bd328d793fa819b92381` (`abel: four was overkerned to period and comma`)
- SHA-256: `8809dcad25318225052f88333e208c5aad4adcb7b2c934c135735ec19aa410b4`
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, reproduced in [`OFL-Abel.txt`](OFL-Abel.txt)
- License source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/3b99d83d2625944fc0b8bd328d793fa819b92381/ofl/abel/OFL.txt
